name: honor-progression
description: Verify server-authoritative long-play Honor milestones, qualified Titan clears, daily/cycle replay limits, capped currency, stable-id relic spending, real HUD/menu input, persistence across respawn, and reduced-motion cosmetics.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='PunchWall Honor Flow Desktop 1366x768' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1366,Height=768,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.4) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local depth={{10,2},{20,3},{35,5},{50,8},{65,12},{75,20}} local rebirth={{1,5},{5,10},{10,20},{25,40},{50,75}} local items={{'vanguard_trail',20,.02,10,0},{'storm_hero_aura',60,.03,20,0},{'relic_sidekick_core',120,.04,35,0},{'crown_of_the_deep',220,.05,50,0},{'titan_vanguard_trail',360,.06,65,1},{'tempest_commander_aura',540,.08,75,5},{'celestial_relic_core',780,.10,75,10},{'eternal_crown_of_honor',1100,.12,75,25}} local ok=G.DataVersion==7 and G.Honor.Version=='PrestigeHonorV1' and G.Honor.WorldClearBase==5 and G.Honor.FirstDailyClearBonus==7 and G.Honor.MaxWorldClearsPerDay==3 and G.Honor.MinimumBossContribution==.01 and G.Honor.MinimumClearIntervalSeconds==300 and #G.Honor.DepthMilestones==6 and #G.Honor.RebirthMilestones==5 and #G.HonorItems==8 for i,e in ipairs(depth) do local a=G.Honor.DepthMilestones[i] ok=ok and a.depth==e[1] and a.honor==e[2] end for i,e in ipairs(rebirth) do local a=G.Honor.RebirthMilestones[i] ok=ok and a.rebirths==e[1] and a.honor==e[2] end for i,e in ipairs(items) do local a=G.HonorItems[i] ok=ok and a.id==e[1] and a.cost==e[2] and a.powerBonus==e[3] and a.requiredDepth==e[4] and a.requiredRebirths==e[5] end for _,reward in ipairs(G.Spin.Rewards) do ok=ok and reward.kind~='Honor' end assert(ok,'Honor config mismatch') return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,depth=#depth,rebirth=#rebirth,items=#items,spinHonor=false})

steps.label: canonical Honor earn and relic matrices are exact and Spin grants no Honor

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('ResetWorld') c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1500000000,FistMultiplier=100,WallLevel=99,Depth=0,Honor=0,HonorMilestoneMask=0}) local rows={} for _,d in ipairs({10,20,35,50,65,75}) do local r=c:Invoke('BreakDepthBlock',{layer=d,column=6,row=2},100) local s=c:Invoke('Snapshot') assert(r.ok==true and r.outcome=='broken','depth milestone block failed '..d) rows[#rows+1]={depth=d,honor=s.Honor,mask=s.HonorMilestoneMask} end local repeatResult=c:Invoke('BreakDepthBlock',{layer=75,column=7,row=2},100) local final=c:Invoke('Snapshot') local ok=repeatResult.ok==true and repeatResult.outcome=='broken' and final.Honor==50 and final.HonorMilestoneMask==63 assert(ok,'Depth Honor milestones failed '..H:JSONEncode({rows=rows,final=final.Honor,mask=final.HonorMilestoneMask})) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,rows=rows,final=final.Honor,mask=final.HonorMilestoneMask})

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') local expected={{0,5,5},{4,10,15},{9,20,35},{24,40,75},{49,75,150}} local rows={} local ok=true for _,e in ipairs(expected) do local q=G.RebirthRequirement(e[1]) c:Invoke('SetStats',{Rebirths=e[1],WallLevel=q.requiredLevel,Coins=q.requiredCoins,Power=1000000}) local r=c:Invoke('Rebirth') local s=c:Invoke('Snapshot') local exact=r.ok==true and r.honor==e[2] and s.Honor==e[3] ok=ok and exact rows[#rows+1]={from=e[1],grant=r.honor,total=s.Honor,exact=exact} end local q=G.RebirthRequirement(50) c:Invoke('SetStats',{Rebirths=50,WallLevel=q.requiredLevel,Coins=q.requiredCoins,Power=1000000}) local noRepeat=c:Invoke('Rebirth') local final=c:Invoke('Snapshot') ok=ok and noRepeat.ok==true and noRepeat.honor==0 and final.Honor==150 and final.HonorRebirthMilestoneMask==31 assert(ok,'Rebirth Honor milestones failed '..H:JSONEncode(rows)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,rows=rows,total=final.Honor,mask=final.HonorRebirthMilestoneMask})
